subject.title: feat: add Fedora/RHEL-family platform support with rootless Podman

question: Should OpenClaw Ansible permanently support Fedora 38+ and RHEL-family 9+ as a rootless-Podman/firewalld platform alongside the existing Debian/Ubuntu Docker/UFW path?
rationale: This PR establishes a long-lived operating-system, runtime, firewall, and support-matrix contract; static correctness cannot determine whether the repository should own that added maintenance boundary.

options.title: Sponsor dual-platform support
options.body: Accept Fedora/RHEL rootless Podman as a supported contract, contingent on refreshed real-host proof for both platform families.

options.title: Keep Debian/Ubuntu-only scope
options.body: Decline the new permanent support boundary and invite a narrower external deployment guide or future proposal if product priorities change.

recommendation.title: Sponsor dual-platform support
recommendation.body: Accept Fedora/RHEL rootless Podman as a supported contract, contingent on refreshed real-host proof for both platform families.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the implementation and can provide the missing runtime evidence, though final product acceptance remains a repository-owner decision.
